is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.l. (specifically sympatric An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s.) in experimental huts and bioassays in Covè, Benin (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No resistance markers were genotyped in this study. The presence of the L1014F mutation (>90%) is merely cited from past literature (reference 33, Ngufor et al. 2015) in the study site description (page 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts/frequencies were determined or reported for this study.

african_field_population.evidence: Wild Anopheles gambiae s.l. entering experimental huts or collected as field larvae and tested as F1 adults were from Covè, southern Benin (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating experimental hut trials, tunnel tests, and WHO bioassays.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the CREC/LSHTM experimental hut station in Covè, southern Benin (7°14'N, 2°18'E) (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Experimental hut trials were performed over 4 months between April and July 2020 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard experimental hut trial and bioassay study conducted at a field station in Benin.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary Table S1 only contains additional tunnel test bioassay data.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the efficacy and potential antagonism of combining pyrethroid-PBO ITNs with pirimiphos-methyl IRS in experimental huts against wild pyrethroid-resistant An. gambiae s.l. in Covè, Benin. No target resistance markers were genotyped in the study (L1014F was only cited from previous work), rendering the paper ineligible.
exclusion_reasons: No target insecticide resistance markers were genotyped in this study; previous findings of L1014F frequency were only cited from earlier literature.
